recorded.rule: Q2 v2: a giveaway, read from the question's own text alone
recorded.prompt:q-sorted-limit: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. Pick an option only when the wording itself singles it out: it is longer or more specific than the others, it repeats words from the stem, the others carry absolute terms such as 'always' or 'never', the stem's grammar fits it alone, or it restates the stem. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.
recorded.pass:q-sorted-limit: an independent agent given Q2_PROMPT, the stem and the options, never the page
recorded.outcome:q-sorted-limit: from the question's text alone, the reader picked none; the key is 'c'
recorded.because:q-sorted-limit: Only (c) has absolute wording ('Every', 'all'), which leaves two options, not one. (a) and (b) share 'five' from limit(5), and (c) echoes 'element', so nothing singles one out.

recorded.prompt:q-sorted-limit:a: Does a passage of the page rule this wrong option out?
recorded.pass:q-sorted-limit:a: an independent agent given the page and the keyed question
recorded.outcome:q-sorted-limit:a: the page rules this option out
recorded.because:q-sorted-limit:a: The tricky-question answer says 'sorted().limit(5) sorts all elements', and it is limit(5).sorted() that sorts only the first 5.
recorded.prompt:q-sorted-limit:b: Does a passage of the page rule this wrong option out?
recorded.pass:q-sorted-limit:b: an independent agent given the page and the keyed question
recorded.outcome:q-sorted-limit:b: the page rules this option out
recorded.because:q-sorted-limit:b: Key point 5 says sorted() 'must see all elements before producing output' and a later limit() 'cannot stop the upstream elements from all being processed'.
recorded.prompt:q-peek:b: Does a passage of the page rule this wrong option out?
recorded.pass:q-peek:b: an independent agent given the page and the keyed question
recorded.outcome:q-peek:b: the page rules this option out
recorded.because:q-peek:b: Pitfall 5 comments on the `.peek(s -> database.save(s))` line before filter: 'Will NOT save if short-circuit fires early'.
recorded.prompt:q-peek:c: Does a passage of the page rule this wrong option out?
recorded.pass:q-peek:c: an independent agent given the page and the keyed question
recorded.outcome:q-peek:c: the page rules this option out
recorded.because:q-peek:c: Pitfall 5: 'peek may not execute with short-circuit terminal operations', so how the run ends does affect peek.
